name: Project Charter
description: Project mandate: problem statement and measurable goals
whenToUse: At the start of a project, to record the problem, measurable goals and the project organisation — the basis every later phase refers to.
problemPlaceholder: What is the problem? Since when? What is the impact? What is NOT in scope?
goalAchievementTooltip: Goal Achievement Level: 0 = not started, 100 = fully achieved
dateInPast: Target date is in the past
noGoals: No goals defined yet. Click "+ Add Goal" to begin.

invariants.uniqueIds: Every goal and every position needs its own id.
invariants.validParents: The superior position must exist in the org chart; without one, a position is top level.
invariants.noCycles: Positions must not report to each other in a loop: no position sits below itself or below one of its own subordinates.
invariants.goalDates: The target date is empty or a valid date of the form YYYY-MM-DD.

confirm.orgDeleteConfirm: Really delete "{name}"? All subordinate positions will also be removed.
